plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Psychology BA program PDF (contains the official Graduation Plan). Semester totals as printed: 16 / 13 / 16 / 16 / 15 / 15 / 15 / 13 = 119, matching the printed 'Total Hours 119'. The program curriculum header states '120 credits'; the official graduation plan itself prints and sums to 119, so total_credits follows the plan as printed. The 4th-year spring 'Psychology Upper Division Elective' slot is printed as 1 credit and is modeled exactly as printed. Course titles verified against the program's 2025-2026 Program Curriculum section (PSY 1010 General Psychology (SS, GC); PSY 1100 Human Development Through Lifespan (SS, GC); PSY 2000 Writing in Psychology: APA Style; PSY 2400 Psychology of Abnormal Behavior; PSY 2100 Cognitive Psychology; PSY 2500 Social Psychology; PSY 3020 Applied Research Methods in Psychology; PSY 3460 Health Psychology; PSY 4000 History of Psychology; PSY 4920 Capstone Seminar in Psychology; MATH 1040 Introduction to Statistics (MA)). 'PSY Writing Intensive Depth Req.' slots per the plan; Depth Content Area categories and the 9-credit Writing Intensive requirement are in the program curriculum. 'Psychology Elective' slots per the plan (12 credits of additional PSY courses, 9 upper-division). Foreign Language 1010/1020/2010/2020 slots fulfill the Bachelor of Arts foreign language requirement (3-16 credits; see GE Foreign Language Requirement page). Prerequisites not populated from the plan (the graduation plan does not list them); see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
